scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres mailpit seaweedfs jaeger && docker compose --profile init run --rm seaweedfs-init
scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env; bun install && bun run --filter @app/api keys:generate && bun run infra:up && bun run --filter @app/api db:migrate
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --filter @app/api test:integration && bun run --filter @app/api test:e2e && bun run --filter @app/web test:e2e
scripts.check:arch: bun run --filter @app/api check:arch && depcruise packages --config .dependency-cruiser.packages.cjs && depcruise modules --config .dependency-cruiser.modules.cjs
